title: Billing Disputes and the PracticePay Patient Financing Payoff Amount
content:
On a PracticePay Patient Financing plan with a billing dispute, part of the plan balance may be left out of the payoff.

**Rule.** The amount left out of a payoff for billing disputes follows their state: while a billing dispute on the plan is open, its disputed amount is left out; when no dispute is open but the disputed amounts of disputes the provider resolved with a credit exceed the provider refunds posted on the plan, the excess, the credit still to post, is left out; otherwise nothing is left out; the amount left out is subtracted from the payoff amount only, the interest-bearing balance and the interest it carries staying as they are.

Restated: the amount left out lowers the payoff amount by exactly that amount; it does not lower the balance on which the payoff's interest runs, so the interest is the same as it would be with nothing left out.

## Decision table

| Billing disputes on the plan | Provider refunds posted on the plan | Amount left out |
|---|---|---|
| one or more open | any | the disputed amount of the open dispute or disputes |
| none open; disputes resolved with a provider credit total more than the refunds posted | less than the credited disputed amounts | the credited disputed amounts less the refunds posted |
| none open; credited disputed amounts no more than the refunds posted | equal to or more than them | nothing |
| none open; none resolved with a provider credit | any | nothing |

Disputes resolved as no error or withdrawn are neither open nor credited, and leave nothing out.

## Examples (hypothetical)

- An open dispute over 300.00 USD: 300.00 is left out. A payoff that would otherwise come to 1500.00 USD comes to 1200.00 USD, the interest within it unchanged.
- No open dispute; a dispute over 300.00 USD resolved with a provider credit; 100.00 USD of provider refunds posted on the plan: 200.00 is left out, the credit still to post.
- The same, with 300.00 USD of refunds posted: nothing is left out.
